Att USAs försvarsminister skriver ”patriots in control” och rysslands chefsförhandlare skriver (svarar) ”WWG1WGA” gör ju nästan foliehattarna till skarpa analytiker – den gillade vi inte.

key_takeaways_en: Back to the fronts briefly but first the US “peace negotiations” – Kushner and Witkoff have thus marketed the ultimate cheat-win for Putin if anyone thought the record was hard to beat after all the cheating for almost five years, and it should have been.

Putin has not succeeded in conquering Donetsk and Luhansk Oblasts so they have asked Ukraine to redraw their internal community borders so Putin can officially claim that he has conquered both oblasts in their entirety and then be satisfied.

This is happening at the same time as Putin has pushed for incorrect staff maps for a year where he probably knows he does not control these areas but he controls the narrative to the US who either believe him or do not care.
